metadata.description: Developer tools and Claude Code plugins by Jonah Schulte

plugins.name: stackshift
plugins.description: Reverse engineering toolkit with manual control — shift gears in your codebase. Analyze, document, and spec-drive any project through a 6-gear process. Dual workflow: Greenfield (extract for rebuild) or Brownfield (manage existing). Includes BMAD synthesis, architecture generation, multi-repo reimagine, and incremental doc refresh.

plugins.name: distillery
plugins.description: Distill experience into expertise — An AI-powered continuous learning system that extracts patterns from completed work and automatically improves code quality through self-updating playbooks. Enables compound learning and prevents repeated mistakes.
